Security review: PASS (round 2, final round under C34)
PR: #237
Head: f62e59ba315e02351a34055dfe5b635782d17481
Request: 01a1ec65-331b-7771-a1e7-bdb8ac38f0ae
Scope: delta only from 81f4a89974383caf7dd5bf727f3f468c0d389ed2.
Confidence: 9/10.

S237-001 (MEDIUM): CLOSED.
crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:623-649 checks every foreign holder before
entering the tombstone loop. An observed-running holder refuses the entire
takeover before any retirement. The exact host process tuple remains excluded.
This live-holder check is a brake: removing it permits more retirement.
The regression at crates/daemon/src/http/identity_tests.rs:2106-2163 exercises
authorized own-process takeover against a running child and checks that the
holder, other holders and queued job remain unchanged.

S237-002 (MEDIUM): CLOSED.
crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:568-595 reads the authoritative prime
designation and requires PrimeState::Current plus matching actor identity.
A self-asserted prime role no longer authorizes takeover; own-process ancestry
remains the fallback.
crates/daemon/src/http/identity_tests.rs:2013-2072 rejects an asserted-only
prime before retirement and then permits the designated prime.

The failed-probe hold-order correction is also sound:
crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1846-1878 resolves holders.unknown to PaneHeld
before unknown_session can select a resumption hold. The added different-native
session regression at registration.rs:2692-2724 injects a probe error and
verifies PaneHeld plus an unchanged incumbent.

No unresolved round-1 security finding, delta-introduced normal-use correctness
bug, or new C34 follow-up was found within the C33 user-account trust boundary.
The previously non-blocking --why placeholder note remains the author's choice,
not a renewed condition or another review round.

Proof:
- Exact detached worktree is clean and its HEAD matches the requested SHA.
- CI run 44219885517 is for this exact head.
- Successful rust-test job 134518842436: 2438 passed, 6 skipped.
- Exact JUnit artifact 14390691432 was selected from that successful job's
  upload log. The following named tests all executed and passed:
  take_over_is_for_the_prime_or_the_panes_own_process_and_retires_only_other_records;
  native_claim_supersedes_only_a_confirmed_dead_pane_holder;
  ordinary_registration_supersedes_a_dead_pane_holder_and_keeps_a_live_one;
  native_sqlite_http_dead_legacy_owner_is_superseded_and_uncorrelated_prebind_is_not_taken_over;
  registration_corroborates_process_and_refuses_shared_process_aliases.
- Node 22 job 134518842454: vitest 2301 passed, 6 skipped; native tests 355
  passed, 0 failed. Its sole failed step is the picomatch audit gate,
  GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.
- Node 24 job 134518842521 was cancelled during npm test; native tests were
  skipped on that matrix leg. It is not recorded here as a passing leg.
- rust-lint passed. Latest delivers run 44219902855 passed on this exact head.

Limits and merge status:
- just pr-freeze 237 reports NOT FINAL: merge BLOCKED plus check22 audit
  failure/check24 cancellation. This PASS is the source-security verdict,
  not certification of green merge gates. #236 remains open and handles the
  audit exception separately; this review does not certify that change.
- Source and CI only: no local build, test, mutation run, dependency install,
  harness boot or harness checks was run, per the review packet.
- No conditional-compilation branches changed. The affected guards are
  platform-independent; macOS compatibility was reviewed statically, not
  compiled or exercised locally.

Harness feedback: the new running-child/no-write and asserted-prime/designation
regressions now encode the two round-1 authority failures. Their execution was
verified in the successful job's exact JUnit artifact rather than inferred
from an overall green Rust job.
